summary: Four adopt/build verdicts, all high confidence, within budget on every tier (T4 not needed). G-2 ADOPT @ag-ui/client 0.0.59 MIT — the hand-roll alternative was rejected on a concrete ground assess missed: EventSource cannot POST, and AG-UI requires POSTing RunAgentInput with Accept: text/event-stream, so a hand-rolled client needs fetch+ReadableStream+partial-JSON buffering, not '~10 lines'. G-1 BUILD in Node: all three candidate homes evaluated — openai-proxy rejected (out of repo, nothing to extend, non-self-contained output), Axum rejected (no SSE precedent; Rust AG-UI crates have 22-399 downloads), Node recommended so @ag-ui/encoder gives the event contract one source of truth. G-3 BUILD following scaffold-react-vite-tauri.sh (230 lines, thin wrapper) rather than forking the 1160-line base. G-4 upgraded WARNING to BLOCKING.
